description: The valkey spec (v2) documents 410 on GetInstance (`responses.410`, sharing the NotFound response), but convert keeps one error shape per named response and drops the status, so a deleted instance surfaces as UnknownStackitError. STACKIT's Go SDK (stackit-sdk-go services/valkey/v2api/wait/wait.go, read 2026-11-01): DeleteInstanceWaitHandler finishes on http.StatusGone, and DeleteCredentialsWaitHandler finishes on http.StatusNotFound or http.StatusGone from GetCredentials. STACKIT's Terraform provider (stackit/internal/services/valkey/instance/resource.go, read 2026-11-01) drops the instance from state on 404 or 410. No live probe: no credentials exist for this account.
